## Natural history notes

A small grass-veneer moth characterized by narrow, delicate wings with pale tan to whitish coloration and fine brown or golden markings that create an elegant, lightly striped appearance. In Florida, it is found in grassy habitats such as prairies, lawns, roadsides, marsh edges, pine flatwoods, and other open areas where grasses are common. Adults are mostly nocturnal and may come to lights, while the caterpillars feed on grasses or related low plants, often living close to the ground within folded leaves or silken shelters.
